summary: Volato Group, Inc. filed an 8-K to report the closing of a private placement of 6,500,000 shares of Class A common stock at $0.34 per share, raising gross proceeds of $2.21 million. The securities were issued to institutional investors under a Securities Purchase Agreement dated June 7, 2026. The filing also notes an amendment to the Registration Rights Agreement extending the filing deadline. This is a routine capital-raising transaction, not a special situation.
